Use this template only to nominate a chapter for revision. To review a chapter that already exists or that a PR proposes, use the Chapter review template instead.

Chapter nominated
- Chapter file: chapters/NN-title.md
- Cycle day this nomination was opened: (1 or 2 — nominations opened after day 2 do not count, per CYCLE.md Step 1)

Weakness (tick the ones that apply)
- [ ] Continuity — conflicts with outline.md or with an earlier chapter
- [ ] Style — breaks STYLE.md voice, POV or tense
- [ ] Cast — wrong names, wrong relationships, out-of-character behaviour
- [ ] Pacing — scene runs long or short, beats out of order
- [ ] Clarity — motivation or geography of a scene is unclear
- [ ] Other (describe below)

Quoted excerpts (required where possible)
> Paste the lines that show the problem, with the line numbers or the section heading they sit under.

What a revision would have to fix
- Fix 1:
- Fix 2:

Voting
- Voting on this nomination is by thumbs-up reaction on this Issue.
- Voting closes at the END OF DAY 5 OF THE CYCLE for every nomination, whichever day the nomination was opened (CYCLE.md Step 2).
- The nomination with the most thumbs-up at that moment, with at least one vote, wins and the cycle becomes "revise that chapter". A tie, or zero votes on all nominations, falls back to "write next chapter".

Do not edit the Issue title prefix: open nominations are found by the "nomination" label, or by the "Cycle nomination:" title prefix where the label is not yet in use.
